provenance.date_note: Snapshot date uses the requested America/New_York date; upstream recorded dates are preserved as evidence, not substituted for this verification date.
provenance.verification: Current local source bytes rehashed against the census and retained image comparison. Historical extractor exports and preserved public GLBs rehashed against current catalog records. Retained labels rechecked at bounded source offsets. Static consumer links inherit the pinned catalog analysis; this pass checks its source ELF hash, not runtime behavior. The disc image itself was not rerun or independently authenticated in this pass.
provenance.image_provenance: The image-comparison evidence concerns the locally held translated game image; it does not establish unmodified retail provenance.

limits: Model records combine historical conversions and preserved public exports; they are not a unique asset or whole-game completion count.
Verified-local means matching bytes and bounded GLB container/embedding checks, not visual, import, animation or runtime verification.
Published download availability and upstream catalog package inclusion are separate from local verification; only existing public models have download links.
Retained weapon and map-info labels are not authenticated canonical names; source versions and ambiguous map labels are preserved.
